programs.name: Brownfield Remediation Tax Assistance
programs.summary: Brownfield property owners can offset the remediation costs incurred at sites where contamination has rendered the property vacant, under-utilized, unsafe, unproductive or abandoned.
programs.audience: Developer, land owner or property owner
programs.zh_name: 棕地修复税收援助
programs.zh_summary: 多伦多市受污染闲置土地的业主可申请税收减免，以抵消场地修复成本。该援助用于解决土地闲置与污染问题，需业主自行承担部分修复费用。

programs.name: Business Incubation & Commercialization Grant Program
programs.summary: Not-for-profit organizations including incubators, accelerators and entrepreneurial organizations aimed at creating business formation, innovation and job creation may receive grants to help provide programming to nascent entrepreneurs, businesses and startups.
programs.zh_name: 企业孵化与商业化拨款计划
programs.zh_summary: 多伦多市的非营利孵化器、加速器及创业组织可申请拨款，用于为初创企业提供培训和项目支持。该计划旨在促进创新就业，通常需自付部分运营资金。

programs.name: CaféTO Grants
programs.summary: Business operators can receive matching funding of 50 per cent for the cost of improvements to café spaces on City property (where a valid permit has been issued) or on private property.
programs.zh_name: 露天咖啡馆补助金 (CaféTO Grants)
programs.zh_summary: 面向企业经营者，提供50%的匹配资金用于改善市政或私人场地的咖啡馆空间。申请人需自付剩余的一半费用。

programs.name: Capacity Buyback Program
programs.summary: Organizations can receive a free water audit to learn how to reduce water use and be a candidate for a one-time cash rebate of up to 30 cents per litre of water saved per average day.
programs.zh_name: 节水回购计划 (Capacity Buyback Program)
programs.zh_summary: 面向各类组织提供免费用水审计，并根据节水量提供一次性现金返还。此项目无需企业自付前期改造费用。

programs.name: Circular Food Innovators Fund
programs.summary: Businesses and not-for-profit organizations can receive between $5,000 and $35,000 to implement reuse systems that replace single-use and takeaway items with reusable foodservice ware that is collected and redistributed for further use.
programs.audience: Business owner, not-for-profit organization, charity or BIA
programs.zh_name: 循环食品创新者基金 (Circular Food Innovators Fund)
programs.zh_summary: 面向企业和非营利组织，资助5,000至35,000加元用于推行可重复使用餐饮具系统。申请人需明确自付金额。

programs.name: Commercial Façade Improvement Grant Program
programs.summary: Commercial property owners can receive up to half of the costs of improvements to redesign, renovate or restore commercial building façade up to a maximum $12,500 grant for $25,000 worth of improvements.
programs.zh_name: 商业门面改善补助计划 (Commercial Façade Improvement Grant Program)
programs.zh_summary: 面向商业房产业主，提供最高50%（上限12,500加元）的改造资金，用于翻新建筑外观。申请人需自付至少一半费用。

programs.name: Commercial Space Renovation Grant Program
programs.summary: Commercial business operators and owners of storefronts that are vacant (or at risk of becoming vacant) may receive matching funding of 50 per cent to undertake interior improvements.
programs.zh_name: 商业空间装修补助计划 (Commercial Space Renovation Grant Program)
programs.zh_summary: 面向商业经营者及空置店面业主，提供50%的匹配资金用于内部装修。申请人需自付剩余的一半装修成本。

programs.name: Creative Co-Location Facilities Property Tax Subclass Designation
programs.summary: Creative enterprises and live music venues can apply for to be included under the Creative Co-Location Facilities Property Tax Subclass.
programs.audience: Business owner/tenant, entrepreneur, not-for-profit organization or property owner
programs.zh_name: 创意合办设施房产税分类认定 (Creative Co-Location Facilities Property Tax Subclass Designation)
programs.zh_summary: 面向创意企业和现场音乐场所，申请纳入特定的房产税减免分类。该项目主要用于减轻税收负担，无直接现金发放。

programs.name: Creative Industries Funding
programs.summary: Organizations can apply for grants and sponsorships for programs or events that foster entrepreneurship, create pathways to employment and position Toronto as a industry leader on a global scale in the film, music and creative technology industries.
programs.audience: Not-for-profit organization, charity, urban off-reserve Indigenous-led organization or community centre part of the Association of Community Centres
programs.zh_name: 创意产业资金 (Creative Industries Funding)
programs.zh_summary: 面向影视、音乐和创意科技领域的组织，资助促进创业和就业的项目或活动。申请人需确认具体的自付比例要求。

programs.name: Dining District Program
programs.summary: Provides funding to BIAs, business associations and other non-profit organizations for projects aimed at supporting restaurants and bars with expanded outdoor dining opportunities.
programs.audience: BIA, not-for-profit organization or business association
programs.zh_name: 餐饮区项目 (Dining District Program)
programs.zh_summary: 面向商业促进区等非营利组织，资助扩大户外餐饮的项目。申请人需了解具体资助比例，用于支持餐饮企业发展。

programs.name: Eco-Roof Incentive Program
programs.summary: Residential, industrial, commercial and institutional buildings can receive grants for the installation of green roofs and cool roofs.
programs.zh_name: 多伦多生态屋顶激励计划
programs.zh_summary: 住宅、工商业及机构建筑的业主可申请补助，用于安装绿色屋顶或凉爽屋顶。项目需自筹部分资金，补助仅涵盖部分安装成本。

programs.name: Economic Development & Growth in Employment Incentive Program
programs.summary: New building construction or major renovation in targeted sectors can benefit from a grant of 60 per cent of the increase in the municipal taxes attributable to the eligible development over a five-year period.
programs.zh_name: 多伦多经济发展与就业增长激励计划
programs.zh_summary: 目标行业的企业新建或大修厂房可获补助，抵扣5年内因开发导致市政房产税增量的60%。申请人需自付其余40%的税费及全部建设成本。

programs.name: Energy Retrofit Loans
programs.summary: Building owners can receive low-interest financing for building retrofits that reduce energy use and greenhouse gas emissions.
programs.zh_name: 多伦多节能改造贷款
programs.zh_summary: 建筑业主可获得低息贷款，用于开展减少能耗和温室气体排放的建筑改造。贷款资金需全额偿还，业主须自付改造总成本。

programs.name: Heritage Tax Rebate Program
programs.summary: Property owners may receive rebates for eligible maintenance and conservation work done on designated heritage properties.
programs.zh_name: 多伦多历史建筑税收减免计划
programs.zh_summary: 指定历史建筑的业主对物业进行合规维护和保护时可获得税费返还。业主需先自付全部修缮费用，再按比例获得部分税费退款。

programs.name: High-Rise Retrofit Improvement Support Program
programs.summary: Apartment building owners can access low-cost financing to make energy-saving retrofits and upgrades to their buildings.
programs.zh_name: 多伦多高层建筑改造提升支持计划
programs.zh_summary: 公寓建筑业主可申请低成本融资，用于建筑的节能改造和升级。资金为需偿还的贷款，业主须自付工程尾款。

programs.name: Indigenous Arts & Culture Partnership Fund
programs.summary: Individuals, groups, collectives or organizations can apply for funding up to $10,000 for pilot projects or $30,000 for longer-term projects centred on Indigenous-led arts and culture initiatives.
programs.audience: Indigenous individual, group, collective or organization
programs.zh_name: 多伦多原住民艺术与文化伙伴关系基金
programs.zh_summary: 个人、团体或组织可申请最高1万或3万元资金，用于开展原住民艺术文化试点或长期项目。资金用于项目运营，超出部分需自筹。

programs.name: Industrial Water Rate Program
programs.summary: Manufacturers can receive a discounted water rate to to help support economic growth and encourage water conservation (also called the Block 2 water rate).
programs.zh_name: 多伦多工业水费优惠计划（Block 2水费）
programs.zh_summary: 制造业企业可享受水费折扣，以支持经济增长并鼓励节水。企业仍需支付优惠后的水费，并非全额免单。

programs.name: Main Street Innovation Fund
programs.summary: Organizations can receive funding for projects costing $25,000 or $50,000 to address main street challenges, engage in innovative place-making and animate main streets to support business recovery and success.
programs.audience: BIA, business association, charity or not-for-profit organization
programs.zh_name: 多伦多主街创新基金
programs.zh_summary: 各类组织可申请定额资金，用于解决商业主街面临的挑战、开展创新场地建设以助力商业复苏。若项目总成本高于资助额，差额需自付。

programs.name: Outdoor Mural & Street Art Program
programs.summary: Business associations and community groups with strong business participation can receive one-time funding up to $7,500 for outdoor mural projects that help promote a local theme and facilitate commercial or industrial neighbourhood identity.
programs.audience: BIA, business association or community group
programs.zh_name: 户外壁画与街头艺术项目
programs.zh_summary: 面向商业协会及社区团体，资助户外壁画项目以促进商业街区特色。提供最高7,500加元一次性资金，需企业积极参与，未明确说明是否须自付。

programs.name: Property Tax Rebate for Registered Charities
programs.summary: Registered charities may be eligible for a rebate of 40 per cent of their property taxes.
programs.zh_name: 注册慈善机构房产税退税
programs.zh_summary: 面向已注册的慈善机构，可获得房产税40%的退税补贴。具体自付比例取决于剩余60%的税款需机构自行承担。

programs.name: Sewer Surcharge Rebate Program
programs.summary: Businesses may be eligible for a rebate on water that is used on-site for their industrial or commercial processes.
programs.zh_name: 下水道附加费退税计划
programs.zh_summary: 面向企业，针对现场工业或商业生产过程中消耗的水量提供退税。未提及具体资助金额及是否需自付部分费用。

programs.name: Small Business Property Tax Subclass
programs.summary: BIAs may receive matching funding of 50 per cent for capital projects ranging in cost from $10,000 to $1 million.
programs.zh_name: 小企业房产税子类别
programs.zh_summary: 面向商业促进区（BIA），为1万至100万加元的资本项目提供50%的匹配资金。申请人必须自付另外50%的费用。

programs.name: Starter Company Plus Grant
programs.summary: Small business entrepreneurs may be eligible to apply for a micro-grant of $5,000, mentoring and advice to assist with growth and expansion of their business.
programs.zh_name: 初创企业增强版拨款（Starter Company Plus Grant）
programs.zh_summary: 面向小企业创业者，提供5,000加元微型资助以及业务指导和建议，以助力企业发展扩张，未明确是否须自付。

programs.name: Streetscape Improvement Program
programs.summary: BIAs may receive matching funding of 50 per cent for capital projects ranging in cost from $10,000 to $1 million.
programs.zh_name: 街景改善计划
programs.zh_summary: 面向商业促进区（BIA），为1万至100万加元的资本项目提供50%的匹配资金。申请人需自付剩余50%的资本项目费用。

programs.name: Streetscape Master Plan Program
programs.summary: BIAs may receive one-time cost-matched funding up to $25,000 to acquire consulting services to create comprehensive streetscape plans that guide future improvements.
programs.zh_name: 街景总体规划项目
programs.zh_summary: 面向商业促进区（BIA），提供最高25,000加元的一次性费用匹配资金，用于聘请顾问制定街景总体规划。申请人需承担50%的匹配费用。

programs.name: Summer Company Grant
programs.summary: Student entrepreneurs, aged 15 to 29, can receive mentorship, training and up to $3,000 to launch and operate a small business during the summer.
programs.zh_name: 夏季公司拨款（Summer Company Grant）
programs.zh_summary: 面向15至29岁的学生创业者，提供导师辅导、培训以及最高3,000加元的资金，用于在夏季启动并运营小企业，未明确是否须自付。

programs.name: Trade Accelerator Program
programs.summary: Small to medium-sized business owners and entrepreneurs may receive a micro-grant of $5,000, mentoring and advice to assist with trade diversification of their business.
programs.zh_name: 贸易加速计划 (TAP)
programs.zh_summary: 中小企业主和创业者可申请5000加元微型补助及导师指导以实现贸易多元化，未提及是否需自付费用。

programs.name: Transit Construction Mitigation Fund
programs.summary: BIAs and not-for-profit organizations with ties to main streets may be eligible for grants of up to $100,000 for community-driven initiatives that mitigate the impacts of multi-year transit construction on local businesses.
programs.zh_name: 公共交通建设缓解基金
programs.zh_summary: 商业促进区和非营利组织可申请最高10万加元补助，用于开展缓解长期交通施工影响的社区活动，未提及是否需自付。

programs.name: Bail Compliance and Warrant Apprehension (BCWA) Grant
programs.deadline_text: Applications must be submitted by Monday, November 2, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. EDT.
programs.summary: The Bail Compliance and Warrant Apprehension (BCWA) Grant is continuing through a new one-year cycle for 2026-27. This grant is to support police services across Ontario in strengthening bail compliance and warrant apprehension efforts, with a focus on high-risk individuals, including repeat and serious violent offenders.
programs.eligibility: Eligible applicants include:Municipal police services in OntarioFirst Nations police services in OntarioMunicipalities policed by the Ontario Provincial Police (OPP)An eligible applicant may submit up to two applications in total, whether as a lead applicant or as a partner in a joint application.For municipalities policed by the OPP, up to two applications will be accepted per OPP detachment. Municipalities served by the same detachment must apply jointly, with one municipality identified as the lead applicant.
programs.zh_name: 保释合规与搜捕拨款（BCWA）
programs.zh_summary: 面向安省市级与原住民警察服务机构，资助加强对高风险及累犯的保释合规与搜捕工作。未提及自付比例要求。

programs.name: Community Sport and Recreation Infrastructure Fund
programs.deadline_text: Applications must be submitted by Tuesday, December 22, 2026, at 4 p.m. EST.
programs.summary: The Community Sport and Recreation Infrastructure Fund (CSRIF) is a $500 million program that provides funding to:
programs.eligibility: Eligible applicants include:MunicipalitiesLocal services boardsNot-for-profit organizationsIndigenous communities and organizationsFor-profit organizations (Stream 2 only)
programs.zh_name: 社区体育与休闲基础设施基金（CSRIF）
programs.zh_summary: 面向安省市镇、原住民社区及非营利组织等，资助体育与休闲基础设施建设。部分流向允许营利组织申请。未提及自付比例。

programs.name: Connecting Links Program 2027-28
programs.deadline_text: Applications are due by Thursday, November 12th, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. Eastern Standard Time (EST).
programs.summary: The Ministry of Transportation’s Connecting Links Program provides dedicated provincial funding for road and bridge projects on designated connecting link highways.
programs.eligibility: There are 352 kilometres of Connecting Links, with 70 bridges in 77 Ontario municipalities.All 77 Ontario municipalities with designated Connecting Links are eligible for funding, a municipality with one designated Connecting Link can submit one project per year, a municipality that has more than one designated Connecting Link may submit a maximum of two projects per year.The Ministry of Transportation (MTO) will provide funding for up to 90 percent of total eligible project costs. The maximum amount of funding for eligible costs is $5 million per road project and $7 million per bridge project
programs.zh_name: 连接公路计划（Connecting Links）
programs.zh_summary: 面向拥有指定连接公路的安省市镇，提供道路和桥梁建设项目的专项省级资金。未提及是否需要自付一部分。

programs.name: Emissions Performance Program
programs.org: Ministry of the Environment, Conservation and Parks
programs.deadline_text: There are no funding deadlines for this program.
programs.summary: The Emissions Performance Program (EPP) is a non-competitive program funded by compliance payments collected through the Emissions Performance Standards (EPS) regulation. The program supports projects to reduce greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions at eligible industrial facilities.
programs.eligibility: Eligible facilities for the program:are registered in the Emissions Performance Standards Programhave purchased Excess Emissions Unitsdo not generate electricity as their primary industrial activityExamples of project activities that are eligible for funding include (but are not limited to):stationary equipment retrofits for energy efficiency and fuel switchingmobile equipment retrofits for energy efficiency and fuel switchingbuilding envelope upgrades (insulation, windows, doors)heat recoveryindustrial process changescarbon capture and storageclean electricity and low-carbon fuel production f
programs.zh_name: 排放绩效计划（EPP）
programs.zh_summary: 面向注册了排放绩效标准计划且购买过超额排放单位的安省工业企业，资助温室气体减排项目。未提及自付比例。

programs.name: Fire Protection Services Reimbursement: Unincorporated Ontario
programs.deadline_text: You must submit your application by March 23, 2027, at 5:00 p.m. EDT.
programs.summary: This program is designed to provide municipalities with reimbursement opportunities related to the provision of emergency services in unincorporated areas of Ontario that occurred between March 16, 2026 to March 14, 2027. Reimbursement rates will be based on service rates utilized by the Ministry of Transportation for fire departments responses on provincial highways.
programs.eligibility: The following call types may be eligible for payment:on roads that are not considered provincial highways by the Ministry of Transportation:motor vehicle collisionshazmatvehicle firesfalse alarmspublic hazard assistance calls:carbon monoxide incidentspublic utility incidentselectrical utility incidentsnatural, Propane or other gas utility incidentsstructure firesrescue (defined as an emergency incident that primarily involves activities directed at locating and rescuing endangered persons and removing those persons to a safe location, this could also include but is not limited to the provision
programs.zh_name: 消防服务报销：未设镇地区（Fire Protection Services Reimbursement）
programs.zh_summary: 面向安省市镇，报销其在安省未设镇地区提供紧急消防与救援服务的相关费用。未提及是否需要自付。

programs.name: Forest Sector Investment and Innovation Program
programs.org: Ministry of Natural Resources and Forestry
programs.deadline_text: Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Funding will follow an open, competitive rounds-based application process. Learn more about current and upcoming rounds of evaluations.
programs.summary: The Forest Sector Investment and Innovation Program provides funding for strategic investments in the forest sector that:
programs.eligibility: Business projectsSupport is available for Ontario-based projects with at least $3 million in eligible costs undertaken by for-profit manufacturers and processors of wood and forest biomass across Ontario, including:saw millspulp and paper millssecondary wood manufacturersbio-economy projectsHarvesting and resource extraction projects are not eligible for funding.Collaboration projectsSupport is available for Ontario-based projects with at least $3 million in eligible costs undertaken through a collaboration of:forest sector for-profit businessesnot-for-profit research organizationsforest indus
programs.zh_name: 林业部门投资与创新计划
programs.zh_summary: 面向安省境内的木材和森林生物质营利性制造及加工企业，支持至少达到一定成本规模的战略投资项目。未明确自付比例。

programs.name: Great Lakes Local Action Fund
programs.org: Ministry of the Environment, Conservation and Parks
programs.deadline_text: Applications must be submitted electronically through the TPON portal by 5:00pm EST on November 6, 2026.
programs.summary: The Great Lakes Local Action Fund provides project-based funding to enable community-based actions that increase climate change resiliency and protect or improve water quality in the Great Lakes ecosystem.
programs.eligibility: To be eligible for funding, the applicant must be a legal incorporated entity, such as:community-based incorporated organizationsconservation organizations (such as non-governmental, not-for-profit, charitable corporations whose work focuses on environmental protection, conservation and restoration or both)Indigenous communitiesconservation authorities and their foundationsmunicipal governmentsacademic institutions including schools as represented by their school boards, universities and community collegesindustry and non-profit associations or organizations
programs.zh_name: 五大湖地方行动基金
programs.zh_summary: 面向依法注册的社区组织和环保非营利机构，资助增强气候韧性及改善五大湖水质的项目。未提及自付比例。

programs.name: Indigenous Transportation Initiatives Fund for Indigenous communities and organizations
programs.deadline_text: You must submit your application by December 9, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. EST.
programs.summary: The Indigenous Transportation Initiatives Fund (ITIF) is an application-based funding program open to Indigenous communities and organizations interested in pursuing transportation-related projects.
programs.eligibility: The following Indigenous communities and organizations in Ontario are eligible to apply for ITIF funding:First Nation communitiesMétis communitiesIndigenous organizations
programs.zh_name: 原住民交通倡议基金（ITIF）
programs.zh_summary: 面向安省的原住民社区和组织，资助各类交通相关的项目开发。未提及是否需要自付一部分资金。

programs.name: Investment Ready: Certified Site designation
programs.org: Ministry of Economic Development, Job Creation and Trade
programs.deadline_text: Applications can be received at any time.
programs.summary: An Investment Ready: Certified Site designation is issued to properties that have successfully completed a set of program requirements to demonstrate that the property is primed for development and ready for investment.
programs.eligibility: The eligibility requirements can be found in the Certification Instructions and Requirements Guide.You can also request the Certification Instructions and Requirements Guide by emailing: investmentready@ontario.ca
programs.zh_name: 投资就绪认证场地项目 (IRCS)
programs.zh_summary: 面向地产所有人，提供开发资质认证以吸引投资。该项目主要是场地资质背书，未直接提及资金资助或自付比例，需查阅指南了解详情。

programs.name: Municipal Energy Plan Program
programs.deadline_text: Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis
programs.summary: Through the Municipal Energy Plan Program, you can get funding to develop a plan that will help your community:
programs.eligibility: All Ontario municipalities (including regional municipalities) can apply.
programs.zh_name: 市政能源计划项目 (MEP)
programs.zh_summary: 安省所有市政府可申请，资助制定社区能源发展规划。具体资助金额与是否需要自付未明确说明，建议直接咨询项目方。

programs.name: Northern Ontario Resource Development Support Fund
programs.org: Ministry of Northern Economic Development and Growth
programs.deadline_text: Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.
programs.summary: The Northern Ontario Resource Development Support (NORDS) Fund will make funding available to municipalities in Northern Ontario to:
programs.eligibility: All 144 municipalities in Northern Ontario are eligible.For the purposes of the NORDS Fund, Ontario considers Northern Ontario to be comprised of:the territorial districts of AlgomaCochraneKenoraManitoulinNipissingParry SoundRainy RiverSudburyThunder BayTimiskamingThis is consistent with the delineation of Northern Ontario as designated in the Places to Grow Act, O. Reg. 416/05.
programs.zh_name: 安省北部资源开发支持基金 (NORDS)
programs.zh_summary: 安省北部144个市政府可申请，资金用于支持资源开发相关项目。具体资助额度与自付比例未明确列出，适合当地市政关注。

programs.name: Ontario Shipbuilding Grant Program
programs.deadline_text: Submit your application by November 19, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. EDT.
programs.summary: The Ontario Shipbuilding Grant Program (OSGP) will help strengthen Ontario’s shipbuilding industry and its supply chain by providing funding for projects such as:

programs.zh_name: 安省造船资助计划 (OSGP)
programs.zh_summary: 安省营利性造船企业或原住民企业可申请，资金用于支持造船及供应链项目。未明确说明资助比例与自付要求，需符合营收资质。

programs.name: Ontario Transit Investment Fund
programs.deadline_text: Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.
programs.summary: The Ontario Transit Investment Fund (OTIF) provides time-limited, application-based funding for up to 5 years to support the start-up and growth of transit services across the province. Through OTIF, the province is providing eligible communities with the support they need to build safe and reliable transit services.
programs.eligibility: Eligible applicants are municipalities, non-profit organizations and Indigenous communities.
programs.zh_name: 安省公共交通投资基金 (OTIF)
programs.zh_summary: 市政府、非营利组织和原住民社区可申请，提供最长5年资助以启动和发展公共交通服务。未标明具体资助金额及自付比例。

programs.name: Pothole Prevention and Repair Program
programs.deadline_text: Applications are due by Friday, December 19, 2025 at 5:00 p.m. EST.
programs.summary: The Pothole Prevention and Repair Program helps make Ontario’s roads safer by reducing accidents and damage caused by potholes.
programs.eligibility: The Pothole Prevention and Repair Program is open to municipalities with a population of 10,000 or less based on the 2021 Statistics Canada survey. To qualify, municipalities must be interested in carrying out eligible pothole prevention and repair projects.
programs.zh_name: 路面坑洞预防与修补项目
programs.zh_summary: 人口1万及以下的安省市政府可申请，资金用于道路坑洞预防与修补以提升安全。未提供具体资助金额及自付比例信息。

programs.name: Provincial Heritage Organization Operating Grant 2026-27
programs.deadline_text: Applications must be received no later than November 9, 2026 at 4:00 p.m. EST.
programs.summary: This ministry provides annual operating support to 11 Ontario Provincial Heritage Organizations. These are umbrella organizations for the major types of heritage activities across the province, representing disciplines such as archaeology, genealogy, architecture, history and archives.
programs.eligibility: This program is restricted. Only the following organizations are eligible to apply:Architectural Conservancy of OntarioArchives Association of OntarioCentre franco-ontarien de folkloreCommunity Heritage OntarioMulticultural History Society of OntarioOntario Archaeological SocietyOntario Black History SocietyOntario Genealogical SocietyOntario Historical SocietyRéseau du patrimoine franco-ontarienSave Ontario Shipwrecks
programs.zh_name: 省级遗产组织运营拨款 (2026-27)
programs.zh_summary: 仅限指定的11家安省特定遗产组织申请，提供年度运营支持。定向邀请制，非公开通用申请项目，无公开自付比例。

programs.name: Public Library Operating Grants, Public Library Pay Equity, First Nation Salary Supplement and Fund for Digital Expenses (PLOG/PE/FNSS/FDE) 2026-27
programs.org: Ministry of Tourism, Culture and Gaming
programs.deadline_text: Applications must be submitted in Transfer Payment Ontario by November 19, 2026, at 4:00 pm EST.
programs.summary: There are four funding streams under this program:
programs.eligibility: The Public Library Operating (PLOG), Pay Equity (PE) , First Nation Salary Supplement (FNSS) grants and the Fund for Digital Expenses (FDE) are restricted programs.Annual funding is distributed to recipients who meet both of these requirements:Operate a public library or contract for library services with a public library board in accordance with the Public Libraries Act.Meet all grant program terms and conditions.Public Libraries Act - Questions and Answers
programs.zh_name: 公共图书馆运营、薪酬平等及数字费用基金 (PLOG/PE/FNSS/FDE) 2026-27
programs.zh_summary: 仅限运营公共图书馆或提供图书馆服务的特定机构申请，用于运营、薪酬及数字开支补贴。定向资助项目，具体分摊比例未明。

programs.name: Regional Development Program: Advanced Manufacturing and Innovation Competitiveness (AMIC) Stream
programs.org: Ministry of Economic Development, Job Creation and Trade
programs.zh_name: 区域发展计划：先进制造与创新竞争力（AMIC）分支
programs.zh_summary: 安大略省企业可申请资金用于制造升级与创新项目。该项目通常需要企业承担部分自付费用，具体比例根据项目要求确定。

programs.name: Road Safety Initiatives Fund (RSIF)
programs.deadline_text: Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis. You must submit your application by December 1, 2026, 5:00 p.m. EST.
programs.summary: The legislative authority for municipalities to use Automated Speed Enforcement (ASE) systems in Ontario has been repealed. As of November 14, 2025, municipalities are no longer allowed to issue any Provincial Offences Act (POA) tickets or administrative penalty orders for speeding infractions captured by ASE cameras.
programs.eligibility: To be eligible for funding under the RSIF, a municipality must have:entered into a signed ASE agreement with the Ministry of Transportation (MTO) before ASE was repealed on November 14, 2025installed, deployed or held a contract or arrangement for ASE systems at any time between December 1, 2019 and November 13, 2025
programs.zh_name: 道路安全倡议基金（RSIF）
programs.zh_summary: 满足特定签约条件的安大略省市镇可申请资金，用于弥补自动超速执法取消后的相关支出。需参考具体政策确定自付比例。

programs.name: Site Readiness Program
programs.org: Ministry of Economic Development, Job Creation and Trade
programs.deadline_text: Applications can be received at any time.
programs.summary: The Site Readiness Program supports investment attraction and business expansion opportunities in Ontario. The program provides funding assistance to successful Applicants to help prepare their eligible industrial properties for potential investment opportunities.
programs.eligibility: The eligibility requirements can be found in the Site Readiness Program Guide.
programs.zh_name: 场地准备计划
programs.zh_summary: 安大略省工业地产业主可申请资金准备投资项目。该资助用于协助提升场地条件，吸引商业扩张，通常需要申请人自付部分资金。

programs.name: Skills Development Fund: Capital Stream
programs.org: Ministry of Labour, Immigration, Training and Skills Development
programs.deadline_text: Continuous intake, applications will be assessed on a rolling basis until funding is fully allocated.
programs.summary: The Skills Development Fund (SDF) Capital Stream offers funding to eligible organizations to:
programs.eligibility: The following organizations are eligible to apply to the SDF Capital Stream as a primary applicant:employers in Ontario (other than the educational organizations listed as being eligible to apply as partners)minister-approved, non-college apprenticeship program training delivery agentsnon-profit organizations including Indigenous band offices and Indigenous Skills and Employment Training agreement holdersprofessional, industry or employer associationstrade unions or union-affiliated organizationsmunicipalitieshospitalsDistrict Social Services Administration BoardsConsolidated Municipal Service
programs.zh_name: 技能发展基金：资本分支（SDF Capital Stream）
programs.zh_summary: 安大略省雇主、培训机构及非营利组织可申请资金用于基础设施和培训项目建设。该项目旨在促进技能提升，需按规定自付部分费用。

programs.name: Species Conservation Program
programs.org: Ministry of the Environment, Conservation and Parks
programs.deadline_text: You must submit your application by December 2, 2026 at 3:00p.m. EST.
programs.summary: The Species Conservation Program was created to encourage people and organizations to get involved in conserving species at risk and their habitats through stewardship activities.

programs.zh_name: 物种保护计划
programs.zh_summary: 安大略省个人、企业、原住民及各类组织可申请资金参与濒危物种及其栖息地的保护活动。项目支持实地管护，通常需自付部分成本。

programs.name: Winter Roads Program: Bridges and Culverts Stream
programs.deadline_text: Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.
programs.summary: The Winter Roads Program – Bridges and Culverts Stream provides funding to Northern Ontario remote communities for new water crossing infrastructure (pre-engineered bridges and culverts) and repairs to existing water crossing structures.
programs.eligibility: Project funding is open to remote communities in Northern Ontario that are not connected to a provincial highway network by an all-season road. programs.zh_name: 冬季道路计划：桥梁与涵洞分支
programs.zh_summary: 安大略省北部无四季公路连接偏远社区的原住民与相关组织可申请资金，用于新建或维修水路交叉桥梁与涵洞。项目需按规定自付部分费用。
